root_cause: Router R1 is missing a static default route to forward traffic to external destinations such as 10.10.10.50 via interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1.
evidence: show ip route output shows 'Gateway of last resort is not set'

root_cause: Switch port FastEthernet0/12 has been placed into the err-disabled state, shutting down the interface.
Subinterface GigabitEthernet0/0.40 is missing 802.1Q VLAN encapsulation, preventing VLAN 40 DHCP requests from reaching R1.
evidence: interface GigabitEthernet0/0.40 shows 'ip address 192.168.40.1 255.255.255.0' without an 'encapsulation dot1Q 40' statement

root_cause: Sub-interface GigabitEthernet0/0.20 is administratively shut down, blocking inter-VLAN routing for VLAN 20.
evidence: GigabitEthernet0/0.20 is administratively down line protocol is down

root_cause: The router's configured DNS name-server is set to an unreachable IP address, preventing hostnames such as webserver.local from being resolved.
evidence: show ip dns view: ip name-server 192.168.1.250 (unreachable DNS server IP)

root_cause: A Native VLAN mismatch exists on the trunk link connecting SW1 and SW2 via interface GigabitEthernet0/1.
evidence: The output of 'show interfaces trunk' reports 'Gi0/1 Auto / Auto native vlan 10 mismatch on native vlan 1'.
